claims.content: The VMU User registers an MSIU Salesperson by capturing their details in the MSIU Sales Team Information Master to enable performance tracking and selection during distribution transactions.

goal.raw_text: The VMU User registers an MSIU Salesperson by capturing their details in the MSIU Sales Team Information Master to enable performance tracking and selection during distribution transactions.

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU User must have valid login credentials and appropriate security privileges to access the MSIU Sales Team Information Master module.
The Sales Team Master must be established and available, as the Salesman record requires selection of a Sales-team which is maintained in a separate master.
The system must be configured to enforce unique Salesman Codes, as the system checks for duplicated IDs for the salesman.
The VMU User initiates the registration of a new MSIU Salesperson to capture their details in the MSIU Sales Team Information Master.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the registration of a new MSIU Salesperson to capture their details in the MSIU Sales Team Information Master.

claims.content: The VMU User accesses the MSIU Sales Team Information Master module.

The system prompts the user to enter the required salesperson details: Salesman Code, Name of the Salesman, DOB & Age, Gender, Communication Address, Contact No, E-Mail Id, and select a Sales-team from the separate master.
The system validates that the entered Salesman Code is not duplicated; if a duplicate ID is detected, the system prevents registration.
If the Salesman Name entered matches an existing name, the system displays a warning message prompting the user to either retain the duplicate name or change it for better reporting purposes.
Upon successful validation of all mandatory fields and uniqueness constraints, the system saves the new salesperson record into the MSIU Sales Team Information Master.
If the entered Salesman Code is duplicated, the system prevents the registration of the salesperson.
If the entered Salesman Name matches an existing name, the system displays a warning message allowing the user to either retain the duplicate name or change it.
If the entered Salesman Code is duplicated, the system prevents the registration of the salesperson.
If the entered Salesman Name matches an existing name, the system displays a warning message allowing the user to either retain the duplicate name or change it.
The new MSIU Salesperson record is successfully saved in the MSIU Sales Team Information Master.
The registered salesperson’s name becomes available for selection by users during distribution transactions.
